title: Lotofácil 3792: Who Won and How the Prize Works
seoTitle: Lotofácil 3792: Winners, Prizes & How it Works
subtitle: The winners of Lotofácil contest 3792 have already been announced
excerpt: Lotofácil contest 3792, held on Tuesday (29), saw three 15-number winners, including one from Feira de Santana who took home R$ 510,000.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Lotofácil contest 3792 was held on Tuesday (29) and saw three winners with 15 correct numbers, including one from Feira de Santana who took home R$ 510,000. The next contest is scheduled for Wednesday (30).

How the Draw Went and Who Came Out Ahead

The draw took place at Espaço da Sorte in São Paulo, and the winning numbers were 02, 04, 06, 07, 08, 10, 11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 20, 23, 24, and 25. Three bets correctly matched all 15 numbers, from Feira de Santana, Araxá, and Juiz de Fora.

Prize Distribution by Matching Tier

In addition to the three winners with 15 numbers, 207 bets matched 14 numbers, each receiving R$ 2,216.99. Six thousand four hundred and fifty-eight bets had 13 matches, with a prize of R$ 35. Eighty-one thousand eight hundred and thirty-four bets matched 12 numbers and won R$ 14, while four hundred and twenty-seven thousand nine hundred and ninety-four bets had 11 matches and received R$ 7.

How Lotofácil Works and the Probability of Winning

In the simple play mode, players choose 15 numbers from the 25 available on the ticket. The minimum bet costs R$ 3.50. The probability of matching all 15 numbers in a simple bet is 1 in 3,268,760. Fixed prizes are paid for 11, 12, and 13 matches; the remaining revenue is distributed among the larger prizes, with 62% for 15 numbers and 13% for 14.

Next Contest and Estimated Prize

The next Lotofácil contest will take place this Wednesday (30), with an estimated prize of R$ 2 million.

With information from G1, Estadão.
